findings.title: SigningKey drop-time zeroization depends on implicit ed25519-dalek default feature
findings.summary: The signer explicitly wipes seed/password byte buffers, but the reconstructed ed25519 SigningKey relies on the transitively-enabled default 'zeroize' feature of ed25519-dalek 2.1 for its own drop-time wipe. Cargo.toml pins no explicit features, so a future default-features=false change would silently drop ZeroizeOnDrop, leaving the private scalar resident after sign() returns. Latent hardening fragility only; current build is safe.

evidence.label: implicit feature
evidence.explanation: ed25519-dalek is declared without explicit features, so SigningKey zeroization depends on the crate default 'zeroize' feature.

evidence.label: explicit buffer wipe present
evidence.explanation: seed and password buffers are explicitly zeroized, but the SigningKey value returned by value relies solely on drop-time wipe.

optionalProperties.remediation: Pin ed25519-dalek = { version = "2.1", features = ["zeroize"] } to guarantee ZeroizeOnDrop regardless of default-feature resolution.
